record.paper_title: Finite translation generalized quadrangles: old results, new results, open problems
record.context_brief: Possible parameters for O(n,m,q) in odd characteristic
record.original_question: For the family O(n, m, q) introduced in the paper, where O(n, m, q) is a set of q^m + 1 mutually constrained (n − 1)-dimensional subspaces in PG(2n + m − 1, q), must one always have m ∈ {n, 2n} when q is odd?

evidence.quote: 1. Do we have m ∈ {n, 2n} for any O(n, m, q), with q odd?
For n = m such a set O(n, m, q) is called a pseudo-ovoid or a generalized ovoid or an [n − 1]-ovoid or an egg of PG(2n + m − 1, q); a [0]-ovoid of PG(3, q) is just an ovoid of PG(3, q).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $q$ be an odd prime power, and let $n, m$ be positive integers. Consider the projective space $\mathrm{PG}(2n+m-1, q)$. A family $O(n,m,q)$ is defined to be a set of $q^m + 1$ subspaces of dimension $n-1$ in $\mathrm{PG}(2n+m-1, q)$ such that:
(i) any three distinct elements of the family span a $(3n-1)$-dimensional subspace; and
(ii) at every element $\pi$ of the family, there is a unique $(n+m-1)$-dimensional subspace (the tangent space at $\pi$) that contains $\pi$ and is disjoint from every other element of the family.

(For $n = m$, this is called a pseudo-ovoid or egg; for $n = 1$, $m = 2$ it reduces to an ovoid of $\mathrm{PG}(3,q)$.) It is known that necessarily $m = n$ or $m = 2n$ when $q$ is even.

Question: For every $O(n,m,q)$ with $q$ odd, must $m \in \{n, 2n\}$?
artifact.category_tag: finite projective geometry, eggs and translation generalized quadrangles
artifact.status_search_result: Searches on eggs/pseudo-ovoids in odd characteristic return work characterizing eggs containing pseudo-conics and related structures, but no source establishes that $m \in \{n,2n\}$ for $O(n,m,q)$ with $q$ odd. The restriction is known to hold for $q$ even (Payne–Thas), and the odd case is repeatedly cited as an open problem in surveys on translation generalized quadrangles. No solution was located.

status_evidence.title: Eggs in finite projective spaces and unitals in translation planes
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses eggs and their parameters; the divisibility/parameter restriction for odd q is not established.
status_evidence.claim: The restriction $m\in\{n,2n\}$ in odd characteristic is not stated as resolved.

status_evidence.title: Innovations in Incidence Geometry vol. 10
status_evidence.snippet: Survey/research on eggs and TGQs in finite geometry, with parameter problems in odd characteristic still listed as open.
status_evidence.claim: Open problems on eggs in odd characteristic remain.
